name: Memories~ Megami no Hogosha
original_name: メモリーズ~ 女神の保護者
source:
“When you die, you become a butterfly and can fly as far away as you want."

MC, high school junior, can't find the courage to connect with her new classmate.  Thankfully, her long missing friends return to help her, bringing back forgotten memories and a change of heart.
But along with them comes something dark and sinister, something that will change Haruna's life forever and, more often than not, get her in trouble.

Can you free all the butterflies?

[From [url=https://cotton-blue.itch.io/memories]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“人死后，就会变成蝴蝶，想飞多远就飞多远。”

MC，一名高中三年级学生，找不到勇气与她的新同学联系。值得庆幸的是，她失踪已久的朋友们回来帮助她，带回了被遗忘的记忆并改变了心意。
但随之而来的是一些黑暗和险恶的东西，这些东西将永远改变榛名的生活，并且常常给她带来麻烦。

你能释放所有的蝴蝶吗？

[来自[url=https://cotton-blue.itch.io/memories]Itch.io[/url]]
